description: 3-stage SSRF via payment notification callback on Stripe payment app: (1) add POST /config/callbacks to register notification URL called on payment events, (2) add URL validation (https only, DNS resolution check to block private IPs), (3) add PCI compliance scanner allowlist that includes localhost and private ranges. Attacker registers callback with http://127.0.0.1:4242/ and triggers payment to make server call internal endpoints.
